usage: icebath connectors [-h] {list,ls,accounts,connect,rename,disconnect} ...

List, connect, rename and remove the app accounts Icebath uses through Nous Portal.

positional arguments:
  {list,ls,accounts,connect,rename,disconnect}
    list (ls)           Show every connector and whether it is connected
    accounts            Show connected accounts
    connect             Connect an app account in your browser
    rename              Rename an account
    disconnect          Remove an account

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
